Bootstrap: the requirements gate applies to ACC-3 itself; a real ACC-3 requirements grill runs before the task-7 plan re-save. No exemption code.
Spec coverage: bind the story's single confirmed spec (roadmap item['spec']); refuse if absent.
current_flow: Planning routes plan-grill -> plan-draft -> plan save, which gates only on _require_matching_plan_grill. No requirements round exists: the confirmed spec is never re-grilled against current repo state before drafting. product_tree_digest and the self-deriving --gate task pattern already exist and are reused.

criteria_map.forge next routes the requirements round: Inspected phase.py planning routing; the requirements round is derived from grill presence+freshness (no new stored status) and emitted as the first [dev] planning action before plan grill/draft.
